text.p: Nestle SA said 1996 group sales rose more than 7.1 percent:

"For the first time since 1993, exchange rates had a moderately positive effect of 1.4 percent," it said in a statement. "Sales volume growth, excluding acquistions and disinvestments, was 2.7 percent."
It said the Asia/Pacific region, Africa and the Middle East all registered strong volume growth. Growth was above average in Europe, due primarily to rapid expansion in central and eastern Europe.

"In the Americas, Latin America achieved above-average growth, whereas the U.S. market's overall growth did not live up to expectations, particularly due to transitional problems in the beverage division," it said.
It said it expected sales volume to grow again in 1997, but did not give a specific forecast.
